label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User-controlled param flows directly to openUrlByHostname(host) without hostname validation. Although isNonPublicAddress checks the resolved IP, DNS rebinding can bypass this—the hostname at the sink (line 46 openUrlByHostname) equals param unchanged. Attacker can supply hostname that resolves to allowed IP during check, then targets internal resources.

evidence.note: User param assigned to host, flows to openUrlByHostname without sanitization
